features.title: Three ways Orbit keeps you ahead of your money
features.subtitle: No spreadsheets, no manual entry. Orbit watches your accounts and does the thinking so you don't have to.

items.title: Auto-categorized spending
items.description: Every transaction is sorted into the right category the moment it happens, so you always know where your money went without lifting a finger.

items.title: Smart savings goals
items.description: Tell Orbit what you're saving for and it quietly adjusts your weekly budget, finds safe-to-save cash, and moves you closer to your goal.

items.title: Bill reminders
items.description: Orbit spots recurring bills automatically and reminds you days before they're due, so you never get hit with a late fee again.

founder.title: Why we're building Orbit
founder.quote: I spent years manually dragging transactions into spreadsheets, trying to figure out where my money went. Orbit is the tool I wish I'd had: an AI that does the tedious part of budgeting so you can focus on the decisions that actually matter.
founder.name: Priya Patel

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before launch day.

items.question: When does Orbit launch?
items.answer: We're putting the finishing touches on Orbit now. Join the waitlist and you'll be the first to know the exact date, plus you'll get access before the general public.

items.question: Is my bank data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Orbit connects to your accounts through encrypted, read-only connections. We never store your bank credentials, and your data is never sold.

items.question: Will there be a free plan?
items.answer: Orbit will launch with a free tier that covers auto-categorization and bill reminders, plus a premium plan for advanced savings goals and deeper insights.

items.question: What platforms will Orbit support?
items.answer: Orbit launches on iOS and the web, with Android following shortly after. Your data syncs automatically across every device.

items.question: How is my place in line decided?
items.answer: Waitlist spots are assigned in the order you sign up. The earlier you join, the sooner you'll get access and the better your launch-week perks.

finalCta.title: Don't miss launch day.
finalCta.subtitle: Join the waitlist now and we'll email you the second Orbit goes live, plus an early-bird discount for your first three months.
